annotation_revision.reference_type: Full-field U-Net-derived temporal annotation proposal, pending user review
annotation_revision.scope: All four upper RGB frames; no lower frames
annotation_revision.semantics: T1 baseline; subsequent persistent shaft, terminal extension, newly observed root/side root relative to adjacent previous period
annotation_revision.ambiguity_rule: Only teacher-flagged crossing root pixels with assigned score <0.5 AND top-two margin <0.1 are temporally untyped; no background removal there
annotation_revision.validation_reference: Teacher-derived proposal; consistency only, not independent accuracy
annotation_revision.original_audit_reference: Byte-preserved user-selected (6) labels; historical same-field model exposure

root_structure_annotation.coordinate_convention: Native RGB pixels, x rightwards, y downwards, origin at top-left
root_structure_annotation.proposal_method: Upload14 anchors; T1 fixed; earlier whole-axis continuation; independent-new prefix after lateral/continuation screening; proposal for review
caveats: Root IDs and crossing/branch/tip classifications are proposals, not verified biological identities.
Fragmented traces can represent the same root; merge IDs after inspecting RGB.
An unmatched trace is not automatically a new root.
No hidden root surface or occluded tip is invented. Image-edge endpoints are not biological tips.
